title: rfc-9597 CWT Claims header parameter (derived)
description: DERIVED - not verbatim. RFC 9597 ships no JSON Schema (the string 'JSON Schema' occurs zero times in it) and declares its only CDDL non-normative. This is the library's fixture-validation rendering over a JSON projection in which an integer COSE label or CWT claim key appears as the decimal string of that integer. THE PROJECTION IS OURS. The CDDL in this directory is the authority on the CBOR.

15.title: CWT Claims (§2, Table 1). Value Type: map

x-library-notes.empty-map-is-valid: minProperties is 0 because §2's CDDL is `* Claim-Label => any` and the source declares it non-normative anyway. The empty map validates.
x-library-notes.label-space: Claim-Label = int / text, flat and global, with no key component. ARCH-0002 P1 wants (defining key, label); nothing here can express that, and even rfc-9943's Figure 3 keeps `* label => any` open.
x-library-notes.placement: A JSON projection has no protected/unprotected distinction, so §2's RECOMMENDED protected placement and its occur-once MUST are UNENFORCEABLE here. They live in the CDDL and in requirements.yaml R-0020 (RECOMMENDED protected) and R-0021 (occur once). [correction 2026-10-21, pass 3 - cross-check] This cited R-0021 and R-0022; R-0022 is the any-COSE-object MAY, not a placement rule.
x-library-notes.no-required-claims: RFC 9597 requires none. rfc-9943 §6 requires iss (1) and sub (2) in the protected header.
